body:
Every love story has a prologue. Hers is a Pennsylvania teenager writing songs about boys who never made the news — years before the famous ones. That's the era our relationship map opens on. Receipts only, no speculation 🤍

altText: Taylor Swift performing the Fearless set of the Eras Tour in Inglewood, 2023, in a gold fringed dress, guitar in hand.
why: X sibling of the 09-17 Blank Spaces timeline intro (see the IG item's why for the confirmed-only, blocklist-safe reasoning). Written first as its own post: one idea (the series opens before any name), the link, no relationship named or asserted. 'Pennsylvania teenager writing songs' is confirmed public biography (Wyomissing, PA; wrote songs as a teen); 'boys who never made the news' means her early songs predate any famous relationship (first documented is Joe Jonas, 2008) — generic, no private individual named, blocklist-safe. Rewritten after round 1's cross-post-copy fail (82%): the X now uses a distinct prologue/receipts frame and near-disjoint vocabulary from the IG artifact open, so it clears the <80% gate; first five words also diverge from the IG sibling. Media: credited Taylor photo, a different era from the IG tile (fearless vs debut); X site-screens prohibited; photoEra unset (a cross-era timeline has no single target era, and timeline is not a THEMED_CAMPAIGN_PREFIX). Weighted length under 270. Lyric-free. rulesChecked [].

critique.rationale: Tight X open for the timeline series — a prologue frame and a 'receipts only, no speculation' promise that states the confirmed-only premise in one breath, structurally unlike its IG sibling. Photo is a credited on-era Taylor tour shot rather than a debut artifact, so it earns its place loosely.
